name: hcportal_getInviteEmailList
description: Builds the recipient list for the portal's 'Email invite codes' action (E2.F2.S6, 2026-10-10) and makes sure each recipient holds an invite code. Called by the API's InviteEmails endpoint with the portal admin's own token, so the codes reach the API and never the browser; the API sends the mail and decides who to skip. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as the context identifier. Gate: the caller's HC.HasherKennelMap.AppAccessFlags for the kennel must have a bit of 0x40000081 (the same gate as hcportal_bulkAddHashers). Scope 'imported' = the hashers named in @publicHasherIds who still hold a live HKM row in this kennel; scope 'neverLoggedIn' = every hasher with a live HKM row in this kennel whose LastLoginDateTime is NULL. Both exclude removed, deleted and EmailBlocked accounts. Deliverability (isPlaceholder) and the 7-day re-invite window (inviteEmailedAt) are reported, not filtered.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: portal device id, validated by HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived token; @publicKennelId is the context identifier.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel whose hashers are invited. Unknown or NULL -> 'No kennel with that id.'

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: 'imported' or 'neverLoggedIn'. Anything else, or NULL -> 'Choose who to send the invite codes to.'

parameters.name: publicHasherIds
parameters.description: '|'-separated PublicHasherIds, used only with scope 'imported' (the hashers the last 'Import from file' added). Entries that are not GUIDs are dropped (TRY_CAST).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on: auth failure (ValidatePortalAuth message); 'No kennel with that id.'; 'You are not authorised to invite members of this kennel.' (logged to HC.ErrorLog as 'Not authorised'); 'Choose who to send the invite codes to.'; and from the CATCH 'The invite list could not be built. Please try again.' (logged).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error or one of the literals above

rowsets.name: KennelHeader
rowsets.description: On success: one row with the success envelope and the kennel and admin the API needs to compose the email.

rowsets.name: Recipients
rowsets.description: On success: one row per selected hasher, ordered by lower(HashName, else FirstName). May be empty.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Hasher.Email (may be a generated address — see isPlaceholder)

columns.name: inviteCode
columns.description: The six letters after 'URC:' in Hasher.ResetCode; NULL if ResetCode is not a URC: code (should not happen after nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode)

columns.name: inviteEmailedAt
columns.description: Hasher.InviteEmailedAt — when an invite was last emailed (column from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-10-10_hasher_invite_emailed_at.sql; not yet in db/schema/tables)

columns.name: isPlaceholder
columns.description: HC6.IsGeneratedEmail(Hasher.Email): 1 when the address is generated and must not be sent to

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode for every selected hasher (cursor, no transaction): mints a compliant HC.Hasher.ResetCode 'URC:XXXXXX' where the hasher lacks one
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the not-authorised path and in the CATCH
Reads HC.Hasher.EmailBlocked (column from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-10-09_hasher_email_status_columns.sql; not yet in db/schema/tables)

codeSmells.detail: Line 52 reads AppAccessFlags from the caller's HKM row without `removed = 0`, so an admin whose kennel row was removed but whose flags were not cleared still passes. Same pattern as hcportal_bulkAddHashers.

codeSmells.issue: 'neverLoggedIn' selects on a bare HKM row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 79-83 take every live HasherKennelMap row, which includes followers and lapsed members, not only members (membership is MembershipExpirationDate in the future). May be intended — 'everyone in this kennel' per the header — but it is not 'members'.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
